items.title: The yield on the 30-year Treasury is above 5.3% for the first time since April 2007. At the time the U.S. national debt was still under $8.8 trillion. Now it's over $39.9 trillion, over 4.5x as large. Plus, in 2007 bond yields were still trending down. Now they are trending up.
items.content:

items.title: Inflation has averaged 4% over the past 65 months. Under Powell, to make up for past inflation being too low, the Fed adopted a policy of targeting an average inflation rate of 2%. Consistent with that policy we now need 0% inflation for 65 months to bring the average down to 2%.
items.content:
